summary.goal: Protect the back, strive upstairs. Doctor ordered 4 weeks off heavy lifting (2026-08-07) after a trigger-point injection series — so squat and sumo run LIGHT position/technique work all block and the loaded hinges are cut, while bench, pull-up and dip push the full plan.
changes: MEDICAL OVERRIDE (2026-08-07): doctor was shocked the athlete is still lifting heavy and recommended 4 weeks off heavy lifting. That window (to ~2026-09-04) covers B5 W1-W4, so the axial lifts run light for the whole block. Real squat/sumo return is B6, on clearance.
Squat: 435-465 @7.5 -> 225 x5 @6, 4 sets, FLAT W1-W4 (athlete asked for a 225 floor; granted as a flat load, so the ceiling drops from the planned 245). ~48% of top.
Sumo: 345-365 @7 -> 225 x3 @6, 3 sets, FLAT W1-W4. Triples stay triples — the lever is load and sets, never reps (sumo-back-cap). No 4th set: sumo is the canary.
CUT for the window: Paused RDL (loaded hinge) and Paused Low-bar Squat (2nd weekly axial session). Neither is worth its risk right now.
Weighted Back Extension moved D4 -> D2 and held at BODYWEIGHT through W2 — the injections go into these exact muscles. Skip it if the sites are sore.
Bench, pull-up and dip UNCHANGED — full strive plan. No shoulder injection was given (2026-08-07), so masked-pain-load-cap does not bind them.
Comp bench W4 stays a range with 'work up to @8' (255-270x2) — the fix for B4's @6 peak.
Deliberate exception to primary-backoff-volume: squat/sumo volume is cut below the logged norm. A medical restriction outranks a volume rule.
accessory_changes: Seated Leg Curl IN on D2 (log median 115) — posterior chain with zero spinal load, filling the hole Paused RDL left. A DB RDL was requested and DECLINED: you already hinge on D4, and a second loaded hinge is exactly what we removed.
Concentration Curl OUT for the window — makes room for the leg curl on D2. Pull-ups carry the biceps. Returns in B6.
NEW: Chest Supported Incline Row (D4) — replaces Meadows Row. Same upper-back target, zero lumbar load on your deadlift day. Expands mid-back without loading the spine.
RE-INTRODUCED: Weighted Back Extension (D4) — your request. Erector capacity with no spinal compression. Starting 45 lb, not 90; the injections still mask pain.
SECONDARY ROTATION (1): squat 3-1-0 Tempo → Paused Low-bar Squat. Bench (Spoto) and deadlift (Paused RDL) secondaries HELD — Spoto is mid-progress, Paused RDL grooves the hitch fix.
OUT: Iso-Lateral Row — you logged it 1/4 in B4, and on D1 it pre-fatigued Tuesday's pull-up (day-interference violation). Mid-back volume now comes from D3/D4.
OUT: Hip Adduction — flat at 115 for months, and adductors on D3 pre-fatigue Friday sumo.
MOVED: Face Pull D4 → D3, so the shoulder-health cluster sits on dip day and D3 carries nothing that pre-fatigues Friday's sumo.
RE-ANCHORED from the log (sheet-load-sync): Leg Extension 90→140, Reverse Pec Deck 45→100, DB Shoulder Press 50→70, Concentration Curl 25→43, Incline DB Press 50→65.

exercises.name: Low-bar Squat
exercises.notes: LIGHT — 4-week back-protection window (doctor, 2026-08-07). 225 FLAT, no weekly ramp: you asked for a higher floor, so you get a higher floor and a LOWER ceiling (was 185->245). ~48% of your 465. 4 sets, not more reps — extra work comes from sets done FRESH, never from fatigued reps. This is POSITION WORK. Do NOT add weight.

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: @7 CAP — shoulder. Overhead is the most bursitis-provocative pattern you own (MRI: mild subacromial-subdeltoid bursitis). Stop on any PAINFUL ARC — pain through the middle range that eases overhead. Two sessions running with that = tell coach, swap to neutral-grip/landmine. Re-anchored 50 → 70.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.notes: Bodyweight bracing. Add load when 3×12 is easy.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.notes: @7. Strive this block. DEPTH IS THE PRIMARY VARIABLE — stop above the pinch point (MRI: subacromial bursitis + AC degeneration compress at the bottom). Full depth buys nothing.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Lat width for the pull-up.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.notes: RE-ANCHORED 45 → 100 (log median 100). You skipped this 4/4 in B4 — it was prescribed at less than half your working load. Posterior-cuff/scap support for the torn anterior tendons; keep it.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Shoulder health — LOAD-BEARING, not filler. Posterior cuff is intact while supraspinatus/subscapularis are torn, so this shares load off them. High rep, never heavy. Do not cut when short on time.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.notes: LIGHT technique pull — 225 FLAT, 3 sets of 3, no ramp. Triples stay triples: the lever is LOAD and SETS, never reps (rule sumo-back-cap). Sumo is the lift that flares your back, so it does NOT get the 4th set squat gets. Tall lockout, no hitch, every rep crisp. Rounding or bar-speed drop = rack it.
